leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the membrane supply felt a little less engaging because it was the only offered combination, though the result clarified that the membrane was stored before joining the boundary.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the cell's membrane-making structures were not explained in much detail.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what the unspecialized cells become, although the final two choices here were straightforward.
